digest.component_or_area: reconcile-bridge-canary workflow and associated CI orchestration
propositions: Reconcile-bridge-canary.yml contains ~200 lines of production logic in YAML run-blocks (staleness classification, alert-lifecycle state machines) that is untestable and unlintable by ruff, representing the highest-defect shell surface.

Classification and alert-lifecycle logic (branchy decision logic for api-error vs zero-state vs stale; dedup-find vs open vs comment vs close) should migrate to a new Python module scripts/canary_bridge.py with four subcommands while keeping CAS push loops verbatim in YAML.

The extracted Python module must preserve existing error-handling dispositions per step: alert-lifecycle writes fail loud (non-zero exit), dedup finds degrade to not-found on CLI failure, and bridge-fsck exit-1-with-valid-JSON is treated as drift signal not error.
YAML workflow steps must reduce to thin env-based invocations without logic-bearing run-blocks beyond the allowlisted flush loop, pinned by anti-rot unit tests.
Post-merge parity validation requires operator attestation that workflow_dispatch canary run shows identical classification and alert behavior compared to the preceding pre-migration scheduled run.
